generationLineage.promptText: Create one original photorealistic editorial photograph, landscape 3:2. Two fictional B2B software cofounders having a quiet product discussion at a white meeting table: a Northern European woman with a dark blonde bob in her late thirties wearing an off-white textured shirt, and a Black European man around forty wearing a simple navy jacket. Natural individual faces, attentive thoughtful expressions and credible hands, subtle candid body language, no staged handshake. Medium-wide eye-level 50mm-equivalent perspective, both full heads and upper bodies safely inside crop with comfortable margin. Modern understated room with white plaster, one navy fabric acoustic panel, soft view through a distant open doorway, a few blank paper cards on the table. Soft daylight from upper-left, gentle depth of field while both faces stay sharp, quiet editorial luxury balanced with real work. No logos, text, device UI, final frame, watermark or implied real customer evidence. No plastic skin, office-stock grin, neon, chromed furniture or excess props.
